verdict.rationale: Docusign publishes an official Node.js client library for the eSignature REST API, and its GitHub OpenAPI specifications repo says those specs are used with swagger-codegen to generate its client SDKs. That points to a family of official SDKs backed by the REST API docs and Developer Center, and community reports describe building production integrations against the API quickly. Missing for 10: only the Node.js SDK is explicitly named (no evidence on other languages or SDK depth), and no hands-on corroboration of the SDKs themselves rather than the raw REST API.
